title: Discord image attachments are written inside the session workspace so the agent can open them (DISCORD-9)
description: Discord image attachments are written inside the session workspace so the agent can open them (DISCORD-9)
acceptance_criteria: A Discord image attachment is written under <session cwd>/.corvidinho/attachments/ (not /tmp); the prompt cites that path; files-read with cwd = the session cwd opens it; git status in the talk worktree stays clean; ending the session removes the file with the workspace.
